title: Senior Manager-PMO (Bangalore - On Site)
description:
**1\. Core Mandate**


* Run the India hub PMO — governance, cadence, stage\-gates, RAID and reporting

Stand up and mature the hub operating model — ways of working, Dubai* India RACI, tooling and working rhythm — and onboard and ramp the team to steady\-state
* Break work down into activities and tasks and manage them to completion across all India workstreams
* Track what people are working on, against initiatives — timesheets, activity and utilisation, with a clear definition of productive\-vs\-available capacity, weekly capture and submission\-compliance
* Own the hub's delivery SLAs and quality standards — on\-time task completion, timesheet\-submission compliance, reporting timeliness and rework / quality — and drive throughput improvement
* Own comms and change management as a core part of the role
* Present the outputs — a standard reporting pack and dashboards to the leadership team on a fixed cadence
* Lead and develop the India team and safeguard the control, information\-security and quality environment


**2\. Key Responsibilities**


**A. PMO Governance \& Cadence**


* Establish and run the India governance cadence — stand\-ups, reviews, stage\-gates and escalations — aligned to the wider PMO rhythm and the RACI with the functional leads

Run the Dubai* India working rhythm — overlap\-window syncs, handoffs and cross\-side dependency management — so India work stays connected to the Dubai leads and no dependency stalls silently
* Operate a defined escalation path with explicit triggers (slippage, blocked dependency, capacity breach) into the PMO Lead and functional leads — surface early, with options
* Define and maintain PMO structure, standards and ways of working for the hub


**B. Planning, Work Breakdown \& Task Management**


* Run a structured intake for work entering the hub — capture, prioritise and assign against agreed capacity — holding the boundary to the Demand function
* Break initiatives down into activities and tasks with owners, plans and deadlines
* Manage the tasks to completion; track progress against plan, manage cross\-workstream and Dubai\-side dependencies, keep critical path and blockers visible, and drive corrective action


**C. Timesheets, Activity \& Utilisation Tracking**


* Define utilisation explicitly — productive / allocated time vs available capacity — and maintain the person\-level view against initiatives
* Own weekly timesheet capture and its data quality — drive on\-time, accurate submission (submission\-compliance %) and chase gaps
* Maintain a consistent activity / initiative taxonomy so booked time rolls up cleanly to initiatives and reporting; flag over\- and under\-utilisation (portfolio capacity\-vs\-demand sits with the Demand function)


**D. Comms \& Change Management**


Run the internal hub comms rhythm — stand\-ups, updates, onboarding comms — and the Dubai* India information flow, so both sides always hold the same picture
* Drive and evidence adoption of new ways of working — track uptake and address resistance, not just roll out


**E. Reporting \& Visibility (Presenting the Outputs)**


* Maintain a single source of truth on India activity, delivery and risk
* Publish a standard hub reporting pack on a fixed cadence — tasks / delivery status, utilisation, RAID, SLA / throughput and change adoption — under a defined leadership reporting contract (what, when, format)
* Build and maintain the dashboards (e.g. Power BI / Monday.com views) that give leadership self\-serve visibility between reporting cycles — no surprises


**F. Team Leadership, Control \& Information Security**


* Lead, coordinate and develop the India team; local line management, onboarding, ramp and capability uplift
* Own access provisioning / de\-provisioning (joiner\-mover\-leaver), data classification and handling, endpoint / remote\-access and clean\-desk standards, and confidentiality / NDA compliance — aligned to DAMAC information\-security policy; target zero data incidents
* Own coverage and continuity (key\-person and BCP) to manage offshore attrition risk, and maintain the delivery\-quality environment


**3\. Key Outcomes**


* A well\-run India\-hub PMO with structured governance and ways of working
* Hub stood up / matured to steady\-state on the agreed operating model and timeline
* Work broken into tasks and tracked to completion across all India workstreams
* Clear visibility of activity, utilisation and delivery for the leadership team
* Hub SLAs met — on\-time task completion, timesheet\-submission compliance, reporting timeliness and quality within target
* Comms and change well\-managed; new ways of working adopted
* A well\-led, controlled and compliant hub with zero data\-security incidents


**4\. Candidate Profile**


### **Experience**


* 8–10 years in PMO / programme management, transformation delivery or capability\-center / delivery\-hub leadership (Senior Manager level)
* Direct experience standing up and running an offshore / nearshore delivery hub or capability center (GCC / GDC) — mobilisation through steady\-state
* Strong PMO background — governance, planning, work breakdown, tracking, utilisation and reporting; proven leadership of distributed teams across locations and cultures


**Capabilities**


* PMO governance, cadence and structured ways of working
* Work breakdown, planning, intake and task / dependency management
* Timesheet / activity and utilisation tracking (productive\-vs\-available, submission compliance)
* Comms and change management with measured adoption
* Reporting and dashboarding — presenting outputs to leadership
* Hands\-on with work\-management and timesheet tooling (e.g. Monday.com, Jira, MS Project / Planner, Smartsheet or Clarity) and dashboarding (Power BI)
* People leadership, cross\-cultural stakeholder management, and working knowledge of information\-security / data\-handling for offshore teams


**AI, Automation \& Digital Tools (Group standard)**


* Practical GenAI skills — day\-to\-day use of large\-language\-model assistants (e.g. ChatGPT / Copilot\-class tools) to accelerate analysis, drafting and problem\-solving.
* Cowork and agent\-based / workflow\-automation tools.
* Power Automate and low\-code / no\-code automation.
* Automation skill sets applied to the function.


**5\. Behavioral Traits**


* Structured and disciplined (PMO\-minded)
* Builds structure from ambiguity (mobiliser)
* Excellent communicator
* Transparent and proactive
* Accountable
* A people\-first leader who helps the team


**6\. Success Definition**



A well\-governed India hub — stood up on a clear operating model and run on PMO discipline — work broken into tasks and tracked to completion, timesheets and utilisation visible, SLAs met and data handled securely, comms and change managed, and clear outputs presented to leadership so they always know exactly what is happening and delivery lands on plan.

As the Program Manager for Digiicampus, you will drive end\-to\-end delivery across multiple modules, connecting customer insights with engineering execution and ensuring strong product adoption. This is a full\-time, high\-ownership role focused on delivery, stakeholder alignment, customer satisfaction, and high NPS.

---------------------------------------


* Own the end\-to\-end requirements gathering process by working closely with the Customer Success SPOC to understand institution\-specific needs, workflows, and pain points across all four stakeholder groups.
* Translate customer conversations and feedback into structured, unambiguous Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) that the development team can act on immediately.
* Prioritize incoming requirements based on customer impact, feasibility, and business goals, maintaining a clear and updated backlog at all times.


**Coordination \& Delivery Management**
---------------------------------------


* Serve as the primary bridge between the Customer Success team and the development team, ensuring requirements are communicated clearly, dependencies are tracked, and delivery timelines are met.

* Author detailed, customer\-friendly Release Notes for every feature or update shipped, ensuring accuracy and clarity for institutional stakeholders.

--------------------------------------


* Monitor which modules and features are actively being used by educational institutions, and proactively investigate gaps — understanding why certain features aren’t being adopted and bringing these insights back to the product and CS teams.

* 3–6 years of experience in a Program Manager, Product Manager, or Business Analyst role, preferably in a SaaS or technology product environment.
* Demonstrated ability to independently write clear, structured PRDs or functional specifications.
* Strong coordination and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders.
* Familiarity with project management tools such as JIRA, ClickUp, Asana, or equivalent.
* A structured, process\-oriented mindset with a strong bias for timely delivery and follow\-through.

----------------


* Prior experience in EdTech or working with educational institution customers.
* Exposure to Figma or ability to read and interpret design wireframes.
* Experience crafting release notes or customer\-facing product communications.
* Understanding of feature adoption tracking and basic product analytics concepts.
* Genuine interest in education and the impact technology can have on learning outcomes and institute operations.

-----------------------------


* Make a real impact on how educational institutions across India operate.
* Competitive pay and an open, high\-trust culture built on passion and excellence.
* Learn and collaborate with top entrepreneurs, technologists, and education leaders.
* Grow with the organisation as projects scale across multiple customers.
* Performance is measured by impact, not hours.

The Transaction Settlement Unit (TSU), part of the Payments team, Manages payment reconciliation for Amazon India’s Escrow and nodal accounts.
